name: invoice-dashboard
title: InvoiceDashboardBlock
description: Multi-file invoice workspace block composed from Keystone UI source and TanStack app components.

meta.fileTree: Installs invoice-dashboard.tsx, invoice-dashboard-columns.tsx, and invoice-dashboard-data.ts as user-owned source under src/components/blocks/invoice-dashboard/.
meta.customization: Replace the sample invoice data with route loader or app-store data, adjust columns in invoice-dashboard-columns.tsx, and wire submit/toast actions to real mutations.
meta.frameworkAssumptions: Designed for Solid apps using the shadcn components.json aliases, Tailwind-compatible class tokens, TanStack Form, and TanStack Table.
meta.interactions: Representative workflow covers command menu launch, draft creation form validation/submission, toast feedback, table sorting/filtering/pagination, and row actions.

parity.shadcn: Matches shadcn-style block ownership by composing installed UI primitives instead of duplicating their source. Gaps: no server actions, auth, persisted filters, or production data loader contract.
parity.tanstackForm: Uses TanStack Form for app-level draft creation while Core remains independent. Gaps: schema validators and async submit lifecycle are intentionally left to the host app.
parity.tanstackTable: Uses the first-party DataTable kit for a realistic management table. Gaps: server pagination, virtualization, and saved views remain follow-up work.
parity.sonner: Uses the Keystone Toast source for workflow feedback. Gaps: no optimistic mutation queue or undo contract yet.
